cases.title: Pre-flight: size and hash
cases.expected: Tenant Test Export reports a UTF-8 size well under 10 MB and a 64-hex SHA-256; Studio shows no validation errors.
cases.actual: EXAMPLE: 24,310 bytes (0.2318% of limit); SHA-256 recorded.

cases.title: Upload to Site Pages
cases.expected: The .html file uploads through "Upload HTML page" into Site Pages without an error or a size/type rejection.

cases.title: Open as draft
cases.expected: The draft opens; styles are applied; all baseline sections are visible; no blank page and no "unsupported content" banner.

cases.title: Publish
cases.expected: Publishing succeeds and the page is reachable at its published URL.

cases.title: Reopen after publish
cases.expected: Closing and reopening the page (and opening it in a new tab) renders identically to the draft.

cases.title: Versioning
cases.expected: Version history lists the upload/publish versions; restoring or viewing a previous version renders correctly.

cases.title: Responsive behavior
cases.expected: At about 1280, 768 and 375 CSS px: no horizontal page scroll, table scrolls inside its own region, long text wraps, KPIs stay readable.

cases.title: Same-site link
cases.expected: The same-site link navigates to the target page (record whether in the frame, top window or a new tab).

cases.title: External link
cases.expected: Without allow-listing the domain SharePoint blocks or warns; after allow-listing it navigates. Record exact behavior.
cases.actual: EXAMPLE: clicking the external link showed a blocked-site message.
observations: EXAMPLE: domain was not yet in the HTML Field Security allow list; repeat after allow-listing.

cases.title: HTML-lookalike workbook text
cases.expected: Every markup-like value displays as literal text; no image loads, no script runs, no formatting is applied.

cases.title: Special characters and encoding
cases.expected: Accents, CJK, RTL, emoji and typographic punctuation display exactly as authored; no mojibake.

cases.title: SharePoint sanitization/transformation
cases.expected: Retrieved or inspected markup equals the uploaded markup, or every difference is recorded as a transformation.

cases.title: Iframe inspection
cases.expected: The page renders in an iframe; record its sandbox tokens, src/srcdoc form and allow attributes.

cases.title: CSP inspection
cases.expected: Record whether the meta CSP is present in the rendered document, the effective Content-Security-Policy header, and any violation messages.

cases.title: Console errors
cases.expected: No console errors originate from the page content. Platform-originated messages are recorded separately.

cases.title: Copilot edit of one text element
cases.expected: Copilot changes the targeted paragraph only; KPIs, table, callout and links remain intact; every other change is recorded.
cases.actual: EXAMPLE: no Copilot license on the test account.

cases.title: Retrieved content comparison
cases.expected: A file retrieved from SharePoint has the same SHA-256 as the upload, or the differences are recorded.

cases.title: Keyboard and zoom smoke test
cases.expected: Links and the table scroll region are reachable by keyboard with a visible focus ring; 200% zoom keeps content usable.

cases.title: Direct canvas edit of one text element
cases.expected: In SharePoint edit mode the paragraph can be selected, edited and saved; the rest of the page is unchanged; no CSP violations appear in the console.
